fields.name: Binding
fields.description:
📚 Professional Document Binding & Finishing Give your hard work the protection and professional look it deserves. Our binding services are perfect for final year projects, business proposals, legal documents, and manuals. > We offer a range of binding styles that keep your pages secure, easy to flip, and resistant to wear and tear. Whether it is a single report or a 500-page academic thesis, we provide a clean, executive finish that makes a great first impression on any reader.

Choose the best style for your document:

  • Spiral/Coil Binding: Perfect for manuals and projects that need to lay flat when open. Very durable and allows for 360-degree rotation.
  • Comb Binding: A classic, affordable choice for office documents and school assignments. Easy to add or remove pages later if needed.
  • Hardcover / Thesis Binding: The ultimate professional finish for final year projects. Includes gold or silver foil lettering for a premium, academic look.
  • Softcover / Thermal Binding: Gives your document a "book-like" spine. Sleek, modern, and great for corporate presentations.

fields.name: Letter head
fields.description:
📜 Professional Letterhead Design & Branding Elevate your official communications with a custom letterhead that reflects the professionalism of your brand. A well-designed letterhead gives your proposals, invoices, and official letters instant credibility.

Whether you need a digital template for sending emails or high-quality printed stationery for physical correspondence, we provide clean, modern, and authoritative designs. From corporate logos to official government or school projects, we ensure your brand looks its best on every page.

 

Why Choose Our Letterhead Services?

  • Corporate Branding: We align the design with your brand colors, fonts, and logo for a consistent look.
  • Digital & Print Ready: Receive your design in Microsoft Word (for easy typing) and PDF (for high-quality printing).
  • Standard & Custom Sizes: Available in standard A4 or any custom size required for your specific needs.
  • Clean & Modern Layouts: We focus on "white space" so your text remains the most important part of the page.
  • Affordable Excellence: Get a premium, executive look without the expensive agency price tag.

fields.name: Flyer
fields.description:
🎨 High-Impact Flyer Design & Printing Make your brand stand out with professionally designed flyers that command attention. Whether you are promoting a business launch, a church event, a school project, or a special sale, we create visuals that tell your story perfectly.

We combine creative layouts with high-quality finishes, ensuring your message isn't just seen—it’s remembered. From digital flyers for your WhatsApp Status to high-quality printed handbills, we deliver top-tier results at prices that won't break the bank.

Our Flyer Services Include:

  • Custom Creative Designs: No boring templates. We design from scratch to match your vision.
  • Social Media Ready: Every design comes with a high-resolution version optimized for WhatsApp, Instagram, and Facebook.
  • Business & Event Specials: Specialized layouts for conferences, parties, product launches, and price lists.
  • Lightning Fast Turnaround: Need it today? We offer express design services to meet your deadlines.
  • Budget-Friendly Packages: High-end professional design at the most affordable rates in the market.

fields.name: Typing
fields.description:
🚀 Fast & Affordable Typing Services Need your documents ready in a flash? We specialize in high-speed, high-accuracy typing for academic projects, official documents, and business reports. We pride ourselves on offering the most competitive rates in the market—giving you premium quality without the premium price tag. From handwritten notes to digital conversions, we handle it all.

Our Typing Expertise Includes:

  • Academic Support: Fast typing for projects, thesis papers, and student assignments.
  • Document Processing: Professional formatting for letters, CVs, and legal documents.
  • Any Format: We convert handwritten scripts, PDF scans, or voice notes into clean, editable text.
  • Speed & Accuracy: Rapid turnaround times to help you meet tight deadlines.
  • Lowest Rates: High-quality service at a price that fits your budget.

fields.name: Scanning
fields.description:
At Beltech Printing & ICT Hub, we provide high-resolution scanning services that transform your paper documents, blueprints, and photographs into secure, crystal-clear digital files. Whether you are looking to declutter your office or preserve a historical document, our industrial-grade scanners ensure every detail is captured with perfect clarity.

Our Scanning Capabilities

  • High-Speed Document Bulk Scanning: Perfect for converting large volumes of office files into organized, searchable PDFs.
  • Large Format Scanning: We scan architectural drawings, engineering blueprints, and site plans (A3, A2, A1, and A0 sizes).
  • Photo & Art Preservation: High-DPI scanning (up to 1200 DPI) for photographs and artwork, capturing every color and texture for digital restoration.
  • OCR Technology (Optical Character Recognition): We don't just scan; we make your documents editable. Convert your scans into Word, Excel, or searchable PDF formats.

fields.name: Lamination
fields.description:
Don’t let your important documents fade or tear. Our professional lamination service adds a layer of industrial-strength protection to your prints. From high-gloss finishes that make colors pop to sophisticated matte finishes for a modern look, we ensure your work lasts a lifetime.

What we laminate:

  • Educational: Certificates, Diplomas, and Teaching Aids.
  • Business: Menus, Price Lists, ID Cards, and Business Cards.
  • Specialty: Maps, Blueprints, and Keepsake Photographs.

fields.name: Logo
fields.description:
Your logo is the most important investment in your business identity. At Beltech Printing & ICT Hub, we don't just "draw" logos; we create visual identities. Our design team combines color theory, modern typography, and industry research to deliver a logo that speaks to your target audience.

What You Get with Beltech Designs:

  • Multiple Concepts: We provide 2-3 unique design directions to choose from.
  • High-Resolution Files: You receive all formats needed for any use (PNG, JPEG).
  • Vector Source Files: We provide AI/EPS/SVG files, which are essential for high-quality printing on any scale without losing quality.
  • Full Ownership: Once the project is complete, the copyright belongs to you.

fields.name: Online Applciation
fields.description:
Don’t let a technical error stand between you and your future. Whether you are applying for a dream job, a university spot, or a government document, Beltech Printing & ICT Hub ensures your online application is submitted perfectly. We handle the scanning, the typing, and the uploading so you can focus on the results.

Our Process:

  1. Document Preparation: We scan and digitize all your physical credentials.
  2. Form Filling: We accurately enter your data into the required portal.
  3. Validation: We double-check all entries against your original documents.
  4. Submission & Printout: We submit the form and provide you with a high-quality printout of your proof of application.

fields.name: ICT

Online Applications & ICT Services

fields.name: Photocopy

  • Best for: Office documents, educational materials, and legal papers.

fields.name: Binding
fields.description:
Secure Document Binding

Description: Give your reports, projects, and manuals a professional finish. We offer various binding styles, including spiral, comb, and hardback binding, to keep your documents organized, durable, and ready for presentation.

  • Best for: Student projects, corporate proposals, and training manuals.

fields.name: Lamination
fields.description:
Premium Lamination

Description: Protect your important documents from wear, tear, and moisture. Our lamination service adds a durable, transparent layer of protection to certificates, ID cards, and menus, ensuring they remain in pristine condition for years.

  • Best for: Certificates, ID cards, and frequently used reference sheets.

fields.name: Scanning
fields.description:
Precision Scanning & Digitization

Description: Move your physical files into the digital world. We provide high-resolution scanning that captures every detail of your documents, photos, or blueprints. We can save your files as searchable PDFs or high-quality images delivered straight to your email or cloud storage.

  • Best for: Archiving records, digital backups, and photo preservation.

fields.name: Passport photograph

Instant Passport Photographs

  • Best for: Visa applications, NIN registration, and school portals.

With worldwide annual spend on digital advertising surpassing $325 billion, it’s no surprise that different approaches to online marketing are becoming available. One of these new approaches is performance marketing or digital performance marketing. Keep reading to learn all about performance marketing, from how it works to how it compares to digital marketing. Plus, get insight into the benefits and risks of performance marketing and how it can affect your company’s long-term success and profitability. Performance marketing is an approach to digital marketing or advertising where businesses only pay when a specific result occurs. This result could be a new lead, sale, or other outcome agreed upon by the advertiser and business. Performance marketing involves channels such as affiliate marketing, online advertising.

fields.title: Beltech Printing Press is Officially Online!
fields.content:
Precision Printing Meets Digital Innovation

We are thrilled to announce that the Beltech Printing Press digital home is now officially live! At Beltech, we have always believed that our customers are our partners. Today, we are making that partnership even easier by bringing our services directly to your screen.

What This Means for You:

  • Explore Our Services: From large-format printing to custom packaging, you can now view our full catalog online.
  • Stay Informed: Our new blog will feature printing tips, design trends, and company updates.
  • Easy Contact: Reach our experts instantly via our integrated contact forms and WhatsApp support.

Our Commitment to You As we launch this new platform, our core values remain at the heart of everything we do:

  1. Reliability: We meet your deadlines every time.
  2. Quality: Precision technology for the perfect finish.
  3. Integrity: Transparent pricing and honest professional advice.

Whether you’ve been with us for years or are just discovering Beltech, we invite you to explore the site and see how we can bring your boldest ideas to life.

fields.question: Do you have a minimum order quantity (MOQ)?
fields.answer: For standard document printing, there is no minimum. For specialized items like customized letterheads or branded flyers, we usually start at 50 or 100 units to give you the best price per page.

fields.question: What types of binding do you offer?
fields.answer:
We provide several professional finishing options:

  • Spiral/Coil Binding: Great for manuals and notebooks (allows pages to lay flat).
  • Comb Binding: Perfect for school projects and reports.
  • Hardcover/Thermal Binding: Best for theses, formal proposals, and law documents.

fields.question: Can you laminate large-format posters?
fields.answer: Yes. We offer lamination services ranging from small ID card sizes up to large A1 or A0 posters, with options for either Gloss (shiny) or Matte (non-reflective) finishes.

fields.question: What ICT support services do you provide?
fields.answer: Beyond printing, we offer system maintenance, software installation, networking solutions, and digital document management (scanning and archiving).

fields.question: Can you help with graphic design if I don't have a file ready?
fields.answer: Absolutely! Our in-house design team can help you create professional layouts for your brand, ensuring they are perfectly formatted for our high-end printers.

fields.question: How fast can I get my order?
fields.answer:
• Same-day: Standard document printing, lamination, and simple binding.
  • 2–3 Business Days: Bulk orders, custom branding, and hardcover binding.
  • ICT Services: Timeline depends on the complexity of the technical task
